observation.source_interface: MNCS Environment Doctor history and capability-intelligence projection

outcome.implementation_scope: mncs_env/doctor.py; mncs_env/capability_intelligence.py; Doctor and capability-intelligence regression tests; Doctor and projection documentation
outcome.implementation_change: Store-backed Doctor recording places the exact immutable evidence reference in its corresponding bounded history row. The demand-driven ECI Doctor-gap projection verifies up to eight recent per-pass artifacts, correlates classified gaps by pass and capability, and reports missing or unverifiable history without reconstructing it.
outcome.verified_change: The Store persistence and projection tests passed. A live Doctor pass wrote one history reference, and ECI verified its content identity and epoch binding while identifying seven earlier summary-only rows as unavailable.

improvement_relation.basis: The implementation is covered by targeted persistence, strict-reference, recurrence, partial-history, and response-budget checks. The live follow-up verifies one authentic post-change Doctor artifact; it does not establish recurrence because seven older rows have no artifact reference.
not_measured: Independent agent discovery or receipt of the projection
Reduced agent intervention, elapsed effort, tool calls, tokens, or resource cost
Cross-session recurrence or causal attribution of the provider classifications
Long-term effectiveness or empirical elimination of the observed gap

related_work.work_intent_goal: Improve MNCS's ability to observe, interpret, and improve how the environment serves agents working within MNCS.
related_work.campaign_objective: MNCS Environmental Capability Intelligence and Continuous Improvement Campaign

measurement_limits: The change adds evidence continuity; it does not repair or alter the provider declarations classified by Doctor.
The follow-up is from the implementing campaign session and verifies one pass only; long-term agent burden and recurrence remain unmeasured.
File-backed debug sessions do not gain per-pass immutable references, and older Store-backed rows are not backfilled.
